[Open the replay in a full page](pages/nipah-families-run-out.html){target="_blank"}. The
agent's own words, in *This turn*, narrate most of the episode.


A deepseek-flash episode on the Nipah-G development pool, trial 0, condition **B1**. The agent
plays well for three rounds and then runs out of leads: it ends with 12 hits, against 26 for
the tuned scripted learner `learner_sim_purchased` on the same seed. On Nipah-G this is the
common pattern; the agent falls short of that learner on average (README, *The agent loses to a
tuned learner on Nipah-G*).

<iframe src="pages/nipah-families-run-out.html#e=0&s=7" title="Replay: Nipah-G trial 0, B1"
  style="width:100%;height:1000px;border:1px solid #ccc;border-radius:6px"></iframe>

## What to watch

**Two leads from the first batch.** The first batch, the top designs by ipSAE and ipTM spread
over design classes, holds 2 hits: a long design of class "Other" and an scFv
([step 7](pages/nipah-families-run-out.html#e=0&s=7){target="_blank"}).

**Both are followed up.** `similar_designs` finds a tight scFv family around the second hit,
and the agent adds long "Other" designs like the first. Round 2 brings 7 hits: "the scFv family
(3/3) and the 220-residue 'Other' designs (3/3)"
([step 14](pages/nipah-families-run-out.html#e=0&s=14){target="_blank"}).

**The families run out.** Before round 3 the agent checks the neighborhoods again and finds the
scFv family "exhausted" ([step 19](pages/nipah-families-run-out.html#e=0&s=19){target="_blank"}).
It concentrates on the 220-residue designs and finds 3 more. After round 3 that family is
"fully bought out" too ([step 20](pages/nipah-families-run-out.html#e=0&s=20){target="_blank"}):
all seven of its 220-residue designs were hits. A last `similar_designs` call finds that the
nearest designs left in the pool are only distantly related
([step 21](pages/nipah-families-run-out.html#e=0&s=21){target="_blank"}). With no lead left, the
agent spends its last 15 purchases probing "the most plausible untested pockets": mid-length
"Other" designs, the unclassified designs and a band of lengths it has not tried. None binds
([step 25](pages/nipah-families-run-out.html#e=0&s=25){target="_blank"}).

**The learner keeps going.** On the same seed, `learner_sim_purchased` has 16 hits after round 3
and adds 10 in round 4, ending with 26. The agent stops at 12. Following a family pays while the
family lasts; a fitted model keeps ranking the whole pool after the leads run out.
